title: Bibiyon ke qaime
body:
abbas alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke hisaar se kis shaan se aabaad thay
bibiyon ke qaime
<<DIVIDER>>
jab khareedi zameen sheh ne pardes mein
zulm ke des mein
thay darinde wahan chaar jaanib khade
khair ke bes mein
jab se abbas se alqama par lagay
gulsitan ban gaye bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehla qaima to khud chote hazrat ka tha
kaampti thi fiza
jaise pehra ho qaimon pe ek sher ka
door thay ashqiyan
hashmi chand ke noor ki chaon mein
jagmate rahe bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyon ke jo qaime thay salle alaa
yun bani qaimagah
ek ek taar tha un mein tatheer ka
aagayi sayyeda
saut e quran se thi muattar fiza
kitne pur noor thay bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke hisaar se kis shaan se aabaad thay
bibiyon ke qaime
<<DIVIDER>>
phir hua yun ke darya ki jaanib badi
fauj kuffaar ki
aur udhar taygh abbas ne khaynch li
jang hone ko thi
hukme sheh pe magar door abbas ne
nehr se kar diye bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
saatween se moharam ko roka gaya
pani sadaat ka
pyaas se bacche karte thay aah o buka
boond pani na tha
shiddate pyaas thi al atash ki sada
se larazne lage bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi sakina ki asghar ki sookhi zaban
aagayi lab pe jaan
ho wo akbar ke asghar ke qasim ki maa
saari shahzadiyan
kar rahi thi buka naame abbas se
goonjte hi rahe bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab ye bachon se sheh ke liye
jaan haazir rahe
sheh sakina ke gohar kabhi dekhte
rukh kabhi choomte
pehra ghazi ka tha shab thi ashoor ki
khoon rote rahe bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
subhe ashoor akbar ne di jo azan
thi qayamat bapa
asr tak khoon se dasht mein bich gaya
haye farshe aza
bibiyan reh gayi berida dasht mein
aur jalaye gaye bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehra dene ko rehaan binte ali
dasht mein reh gayi
pursa dene raza aaye maula ali
kaampti thi zameen
jal gaye thay magar raah abbas ki
phir bhi takte rahe bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
author: Rehaan Azmi
